title: IT Asset Management
description: Manage the lifecycle of hardware, software, and cloud assets. Tests asset discovery, license optimization, and retirement planning.

seo.overviewBody: IT Asset Management (ITAM) tracks hardware and software assets from procurement to secure disposal. IT managers evaluate candidates on inventory auditing, software license compliance, asset tracking databases, and secure data sanitization.

deliverables.title: 1. IT Asset Lifecycle & Disposal Policy
deliverables.desc: Policy document establishing asset tagging, procurement workflows, hardware depreciation, and secure disposal guidelines.

deliverables.title: 2. Asset & License Inventory Database
deliverables.desc: Inventory database tracking laptop serial numbers, assigned users, software license keys, and warranty expiration dates.

deliverables.title: 3. NIST 800-88 Data Sanitization Log
deliverables.desc: Certificate of destruction log verifying full disk sanitization using NIST 800-88 compliant wiping tools before hardware disposal.

faqs.question: Why is NIST 800-88 data sanitization required before hardware disposal?
faqs.answer: Simply formatting a drive leaves recoverable data. NIST 800-88 wiping overwrites drive sectors with pseudo-random data to prevent data leakage.

faqs.question: What is software license audit risk?
faqs.answer: Using un-licensed software can lead to financial penalties from software vendors during compliance audits.

faqs.question: How does asset tagging improve hardware tracking?
faqs.answer: Unique barcode/QR asset tags allow rapid physical inventory reconciliation during annual hardware audits.
